item.description: ### Fixed - **Installing Codex while Perch is running is now noticed.** 0.5.7 said pressing Re-check would pick it up, but Re-check sits inside the very warning that gets hidden when Perch thinks Codex isn't there — so it wasn't available exactly when you'd want it. Simply opening Settings now looks again. - **Perch no longer stays quiet just because it couldn't find Codex once.** If the check fails for some passing reason rather than because Codex is genuinely missing, the hook-trust warning is shown rather than swallowed. Only a real absence hides it. - A lookup already under way can no longer overwrite a newer, correct one and put Perch back to believing Codex is missing. - **Settings now re-checks Codex every time you open it, not just the first time.** The window is kept around and reused between openings, so the checks that were meant to run on each visit were quietly only running once per launch — including the "are these hooks still trusted?" check.
